text: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，规划坚持底线思维、安全为基，清洁高效、绿色低碳，创新驱动、产业升级，市场导向、提升效能，民生优先、融合发展的原则。到2030年，煤炭兜底保障能力进一步增强，生产开发布局持续优化，优质先进产能比重进一步提升，产供储销体系更加完善，全国大型现代化煤矿产能比重提升至87%；安全绿色开发和清洁高效利用水平明显提高，全系统智能化建设深入推进，智能化煤矿产能比例提升至75%；煤基多元化产业格局加快形成，煤炭消费实现达峰，供需动态平衡保障机制进一步健全，行业现代化治理能力显著提高，现代煤炭产业体系
text_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which states the plan adheres to the principles of bottom-line thinking and safety as the foundation, clean efficiency and green low-carbon, innovation-driven industrial upgrading, market orientation and efficiency enhancement, and people's livelihood priority with integrated development. By 2030, coal's safety net guarantee capacity will be further strengthened, production and development layout continuously optimized, the share of quality advanced capacity further increased, and the production-supply-storage-sales system more complete, with the share of large modern coal mines rising to 87%. Safe green development and clean efficient utilization levels will improve markedly, full-system intelligent construction will be advanced, and the share of intelligent coal mine capacity will rise to 75%. A coal-based diversified industrial pattern will take shape faster, coal consumption will peak, the dynamic supply-demand balance guarantee mechanism will be further improved, industry modernization governance capacity notably enhanced, and a modern coal industry system basically established.
